resist: Rohm and Haas XP 5271 / MET-2D (EUV chemically amplified resist of the Berkeley-MET era, 2007-2011)
note: Assembled from four independent measurement groups on the same commercial resist; batches and PEB conditions differ per source (stated per entry). Not a single-source set.

lbnl_film_quantum_yield.source: Brainard et al. (LBNL), Film Quantum Yields of EUV & Ultra-High PAG Photoresists, OSTI 1004159, Table 3 (XP5271D)

sekiguchi_2011_table6_euv_met2d.source: A. Sekiguchi, Approach to EUV Lithography Simulation, InTech 2011, ch. 9, Table 6 (EUV MET-2D column); PAB 130 C/60 s, film 125 nm, PEB 110 C/90 s

anderson_naulleau_2008_osti_950847.source: C. N. Anderson, P. P. Naulleau, Don't always blame the photons (OSTI 950847), Tables I and II, XP 5271 base series J/K/D
anderson_naulleau_2008_osti_950847.optics: SEMATECH Berkeley MET, NA 0.3, annular illumination sigma 0.35-0.55, LBNL 5,2 dark-field mask
anderson_naulleau_2008_osti_950847.blur_definition: HOST-PSF deprotection blur = average width of the volume rendered dissolvable by one acid (a width, FWHM-like; Naulleau's Gaussian PSF fits are quoted as FWHM); sigma ~ blur/2.355 with that reading
anderson_naulleau_2008_osti_950847.e_size_definition: dose to print 50 nm 1:1 features at coded size at best focus (SPIE 2008 dose calibration)
anderson_naulleau_2008_osti_950847.ler_definition: average of 54 single-line LER values in a 3x3 dose-focus window, passband 10-834 nm, Hitachi S-4800 2 kV, no noise correction stated
anderson_naulleau_2008_osti_950847.sem_bias_note: Hitachi S-4800, 2 kV, 100-150k magnification, no noise correction; no bias value published -> LER values are upper bounds

naulleau_2006_psf_osti_900654.source: P. Naulleau et al., Modeling of EUV photoresists with a resist point spread function (OSTI 900654)
naulleau_2006_psf_osti_900654.note: MET-2D not in this paper; FWHM convention documented here
